writeout: support to generate JSON output

This commit adds support to generate JSON via the writeout feature:

    -w "%{json}"

It leverages the existing infrastructure as much as possible. Thus,
generating the JSON on STDERR is possible by:

    -w "%{stderr}%{json}"

This implements a variant of
https://github.com/curl/curl/wiki/JSON#--write-out-json.

part.text:
No files were modified (the only untracked item is the pre-existing `.zvec-grep/` index directory).

## Answer

**Yes.** curl supports printing all available transfer stats as a single JSON object via `-w "%{json}"`. The example you saw is real and is still supported at this pinned commit — `src/tool_writeout.c` registers the variable and `src/tool_writeout_json.c` implements it:

```c
  {"header_json", VAR_HEADER_JSON, CURLINFO_NONE, NULL},
  {"json",        VAR_JSON,        CURLINFO_NONE, NULL},
```

and tests exercise it (`tests/data/test970`: `--write-out '%{json}'`).

### Establishing commit

**`04c03416e68fd635a15cae8201872f5c29fdcca8`** — "writeout: support to generate JSON output"
Mathias Gumz, 2020-02-01 (shipped in curl 7.70.0; verified an ancestor of HEAD via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`).

Quoting the commit message:

> writeout: support to generate JSON output
>
> This commit adds support to generate JSON via the writeout feature:
>
>     -w "%{json}"
>
> It leverages the existing infrastructure as much as possible. Thus,
> generating the JSON on STDERR is possible by:
>
>     -w "%{stderr}%{json}"
>
> This implements a variant of
> https://github.com/curl/curl/wiki/JSON#--write-out-json.
>
> Closes #4870

And from that commit's diff to `docs/cmdline-opts/write-out.d`:

```diff
+.B json
+A JSON object with all available keys.
```

The commit also added the new file `src/tool_writeout_json.c` (181 lines) plus `src/tool_writeout_json.h`, which are still the implementation at HEAD.

### Supporting/related history

- `65ca22946` — `tool_writeout: refactor write-out and write-out json`
- `4133a69f2` — `curl: add %{header_json} support in -w handling` ("Outputs all response headers as a JSON object.") — a separate key for response headers as JSON, 2022-03-17.
- `842be672c` — `tool_writeout_json. fix the output for duplicate header names`
- `1a46b218d` (`RELEASE-NOTES: synced`, 7.70.0) lists: `o writeout: support to generate JSON output with '%{json}' [8]`, confirming the feature's release version.
